book: Casaubon's 1590 Greek-Latin edition of Aristotle's Opera omnia (Lugduni), a multi-work volume that opens with front matter (preface, lives of Aristotle, index of contents) and then the logical works: Porphyry's Isagoge, the Categoriae, De interpretatione and the Analytica priora; the sheet covers only scans 6 to 298 of 777, and the entries cover those scans.
